integrity: Analytical proof is separate from finite exact-integer regression checks; no finite check is claimed to establish universal quantifiers.
scientific_limitations: Independent three-point summands only, both parity classes positive; the half-unit conclusion assumes every component probability positive. General-class sharpness uses tied conditional modes; no unconditional modal bound is claimed. The proof uses classical weak Hermite--Biehler interlacing and a deletion-mode comparison. Historical priority requires independent review.
title: Sharp modal alignment for the two parity classes of a Poisson-trinomial sum
